notes.text: Starting recovery on DEP01-B — pulling the PM record and hold status.
Wet clean with seasoning done — checking history for drift and seasoning risks.
History shows seasoning was adequate and no new-part drift — verifying metrology alignment next.
Metrology tools agree — running a baseline monitor to measure the clean rate.
First monitor reads slightly thick — estimating the corrected recipe time.
Estimate points to 59.48s and confirms the old recipe would run out-of-spec — running a confirmatory monitor at the new time.
Confirmatory wafer lands near target — refining the estimate with both monitors.
Both monitors confirm a stable, on-target rate — releasing the chamber to production.
Release needs exact number formatting — fixing and resubmitting.

truth.explanation: The clean removed the wall buildup, so the rate came back up; the pre-PM recipe runs thick.
